developer: Jefferson Lab / SURATech / U.S. Department of Energy
status_detail: Newport News EDA reported June 13, 2026 groundbreaking for a 30,000 sq ft Jefferson Lab Data Center with a roughly 10,000 sq ft data hall; construction expected to start later in 2026, built in about 18 months, with HPDF operational in 2030.
notes: Scientific/research data facility rather than a commercial hyperscale cloud site; article says roughly $43M state funding plus $6M seed funding and future DOE HPDF project cost of $300M-$500M.

project_name: Dozier Road / Fort Eustis potential data center site
status_detail: Local reporting says a site off Dozier Road near Fort Eustis was identified as a potential data center location, but Newport News officials said in early 2026 that there was no proposal, no conversations, plans, or negotiations underway.
notes: Included as an early/conceptual site to avoid omission; not a filed project as of the cited city statements.

status_detail: Leasing material identifies EdgeConneX as occupying about 20,000 sq ft in the 100,000 sq ft 3800 Village Avenue facility and describes the site as Tier 3 with expansion capability to 10 MW; Cleanview lists EdgeConneX NOR01 as operating in Norfolk City with 1 MW capacity.
notes: Capacity is recorded as 10 MW because the property leasing PDF states expansion capability to 10 MW; tracker lists 1 MW current operating capacity, so treat 10 MW as maximum/expandable.

Many hits were for Northampton County, Pennsylvania or Northampton County, North Carolina and were excluded.
notes: No project found for Northampton County, Virginia.

status_detail: County planning minutes include only hypothetical discussion of whether a data center locating in Northumberland County would be good or bad; no application, permit, rezoning, developer, or site-specific project was found.
notes: Excluded Northumberland, England QTS/Cambois results and generic vendor SEO pages.

notes: Mineral Gap Data Center is nearby in Wise County, not Norton city; Ohio/Summit County Norton proposal results were excluded.

developer: Amazon Web Services / Amazon Data Services (reported)
status_detail: Orange County lists REZ 22-03 Wilderness Crossing as an approved past project; tracker and preservation/news sources report Amazon-related data centers within the larger 2,600-acre Wilderness Crossing development, with Baxtel listing the data center as planned for 2027 and 732 acres allocated for data centers and distribution warehouses.
notes: Official county page confirms Wilderness Crossing rezoning/project materials, but the data-center/Amazon attribution is from tracker and advocacy/news sources rather than a county project page. Orange County also adopted a Technology District and disclosed NDAs with potential data center developers in 2026.

project_name: Premier Technical Services Page County data center
aliases: Premier Technical Services COOP and data center facility
status_detail: State/VACo and DCD reports in 2008 announced a $16.5M Premier Technical Services data center and office/COOP facility in Page County with 96 jobs and Governor's Opportunity Fund support; later local reporting says the project was repeatedly delayed, county financial support was discontinued in 2010, and federal customers backed out in 2011.
notes: Historical project included for completeness; no reliable evidence found that it became operational. Page County 2025 minutes discuss data center pros/cons and a Shenandoah Valley Partnership site ranking, but no specific current application was found.

status_detail: Local reporting on June 30, 2026 says no data centers had been proposed in Patrick County as of publication, while supervisors debated whether to create a data center ordinance.
notes: No official/site-specific project found; generic vendor SEO pages were excluded.

project_name: NuVu Real Estate County Drive data center campus
status_detail: Richmond BizSense/WTVR reported NuVu submitted a 75-acre, 300 MW facility in May 2025 and secured Petersburg's first site-plan approval for a data center; city current-projects map lists County Drive Data Center.
notes: Reported investment up to $1.1B; project did not require rezoning because data centers are by-right in Petersburg M-1/M-2 industrial districts.

status_detail: DCD/Richmond BizSense reported Menlo Digital has a four-building campus planned on a 74-acre site at 2255 Jamestown Drive, listed by Menlo as MD-VA3, with 104 MW at full build-out and a 300 MW substation; Petersburg's current-projects map lists Jamestown Dr Data Center.
notes: City 2023 minutes show rezoning of 2255 Jamestown Road and 2262 County Drive to M-1, though the later data center details are from news/industry reporting.

status_detail: DCD/Richmond BizSense reported Wagner Properties is working on a data center at 1161 Wagner Road; Petersburg's current-projects map lists Wagner Road Data Center.
notes: Limited public detail found; included because city current-projects map and industry/local news identify the project.

project_name: Warrenton Group Halifax Road data center campus
status_detail: Petersburg agenda materials describe a Warrenton Group request to expand/amend the 2233 Halifax Road M-1 rezoning for a data center; the concept plan shows six data centers, a gatehouse and an electric substation, and the city current-projects map lists Collier Yard Data Center. DCD/Richmond BizSense describe it as a six-building, 175-acre campus at 2233 Halifax Road.
notes: City document says TWG Petersburg LLC sought an option to buy approximately 179 acres at 2233 Halifax Road for a high-efficiency stacked data center or similar/better commercial development.
